title: Lead-Time-Centric Evaluation of Bearing Anomaly Detectors and the Effect of SCADA-Rate Logging on Warning Time: An Ungameable Metric and a Multi-Dataset Study
description: A reproducible benchmark that makes lead time, gated by a leakage-free false-alarm rate, the primary metric for evaluating rolling-element bearing anomaly detectors, and uses it to test whether SCADA-rate bin-averaging destroys detection lead time. Across four run-to-failure datasets (NASA IMS, a real ONGC gas-turbine SCADA record, XJTU-SY, and FEMTO/PRONOSTIA) with run-level statistics and Holm correction, the headline finding is non-destruction: coarse SCADA-rate logging does not cost bearing-fault warning time.
